examples: I was ignorant of the rules.
She is ignorant of the news.

more.def: Not having knowledge or information about something.
examples: I was ignorant of the new rule.
She was ignorant of the danger.
He was ignorant about how to use the machine.

easy.def: To not pay attention to something.
examples: Ignore the noise and keep reading.
The cat ignores me when I call.
Do not ignore the stop sign.

more.def: To pay no attention to someone or something on purpose.
examples: He ignored the ringing phone and finished his homework.
She ignored the teasing and kept playing.
If you ignore a small leak, it can become a big problem.
